settings.stamp_text: CARVED BY HAND · NO TWO ALIKE
settings.heading: Why I Started This — Jim
settings.text:
I'm Jim. I started this shop because I was tired of seeing “American” flag décor that turned out to be a flat picture printed on plastic and shipped in from the other side of the world. It never felt like the thing it was supposed to honor.

A hand-carved flag is different. The stars, the stripes, the eagle — all of it carved in real relief out of solid wood, so you can run your fingers across the grain and feel the work in it. That's what I wanted hanging in my own home, and what I wanted to put in front of other families who feel the same way about where things come from and how they're made.

Every flag is carved and finished by hand in small batches. I look over each one before it ships, and if it isn't right, it doesn't go out. If yours ever arrives less than perfect, we replace it free — no forms, no fuss. That's the whole arrangement.

Thanks for being here, and for caring about the real thing.
Arrives damaged? Replaced free — no questions

settings.text: If it doesn't stop you in your tracks every time you walk past it, tell us. Full refund, no forms, no hard feelings — you don't even need to ship it back.
